title: Uber uses AI for cost savings and operational efficiency
excerpt: Uber uses AI for small operational changes, keeping AI spending stable while enhancing app features and efficiency, CEO Dara Khosrowshahi reports.
content_html:
Uber keeps AI spending stable using cheaper models and employees tracking cost, CFO says

By Alex Bitter

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

AI is reshaping Uber — gradually, and as it keeps a handle on AI spending.

The ride-hailing company kept a lid on its token spending during the second quarter by "by setting better defaults for different use cases," using lower-cost models for some tasks, and "letting employees more clearly understand and manage their spend," CFO Balaji Krishnamurthy said in prepared remarks after the company reported quarterly earnings on Wednesday.

"As a result, cost per token has declined over the past several months, even as adoption has continued to increase, allowing us to keep overall AI spend broadly stable," Krishnamurthy said.

Earlier this year, CTO Praveen Neppalli Naga went viral after saying that Uber had spent its Claude Code budget for 2026 after just a few months.

These days, Uber is also using AI to make lots of tiny changes to its app and offerings instead of taking big swings, CEO Dara Khosrowshahi said on the company's earnings call on Wednesday.

One example: Using AI, Uber provides destination suggestions when customers open the app to request a ride. Three-quarters of the time, the app correctly predicts where the ride is going with those suggestions, Khosrowshahi said.

"A lot of people expect these technologies that are revolutionary — and AI is revolutionary — to have some giant hit," he said.

Instead, "it's going to be thousands of small hits and improvements to our ecosystem that's going to drive, we think, growth for the foreseeable future," Khosrowshahi added.

Uber is also reshaping its internal operations with AI. The company laid off about 10% of its customer service workers last month, citing the opportunity for efficiency gains from AI.

On Wednesday's call, Krishnamurthy pointed to customer service as "a clear area where we should be able to up the quality of our customer support interactions as well as reduce the cost of our effort."

The company has also used "agentic pods" to find uses for AI from finance to HR.

Uber's consumer-facing uses of AI are also progressing, though they are unlikely to come all at once, Khosrowshahi said on the call.

Uber facilitates "hundreds of thousands" of rides in self-driving cars each week — less than 0.5% of the 300 million trips that happen through the app in the same period, the CEO said.

By contrast, AI has already become common for many online search users, Khosrowshahi said. Unlike AI chatbots, Uber's physical use of AI through robotaxis requires real-world testing and government approvals, he added.

Uber is also experimenting with other uses of AI that "improve the fundamental experience of the consumer," Khosrowshahi said. He pointed to Cart Assistant, which can create a shopping cart of grocery items in the Uber app from a recipe or shopping list and edit the cart based on feedback from customers.

Cart Assistant users have cart sizes that are twice as large as those of users who didn't use the AI tool, Khosrowshahi said.

"You should expect AI to contribute to average order size, the quality and reliability of our service as well, and putting the right product in front of you at the right time," he said.

首席财务官表示，Uber 使用更便宜的模型和员工跟踪成本来保持人工智能支出稳定

作者：Alex Bitter 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

人工智能正在逐渐重塑 Uber，并且它控制着人工智能支出。

该公司首席财务官巴拉吉·克里希纳穆蒂(Balaji Krishnamurthy)在公司周三公布季度收益后在准备好的讲话中表示，这家叫车公司通过“为不同的用例设置更好的默认值”、对某些任务使用成本更低的模型以及“让员工更清楚地了解和管理他们的支出”，限制了第二季度的代币支出。

Krishnamurthy 表示：“因此，尽管采用率持续增加，但在过去几个月里，每个代币的成本有所下降，这使我们能够保持整体人工智能支出的基本稳定。”

今年早些时候，首席技术官 Praveen Neppalli Naga 表示 Uber 在短短几个月后就用完了 2026 年的 Claude Code 预算，这一消息在网上疯传。

优步首席执行官达拉·科斯罗萨西 (Dara Khosrowshahi) 在周三的公司财报电话会议上表示，如今，优步还利用人工智能对其应用程序和产品进行许多微小的改变，而不是进行大的调整。

举个例子：当客户打开应用程序叫车时，Uber 使用人工智能提供目的地建议。 科斯罗萨西说，四分之三的情况下，应用程序会根据这些建议正确预测行程的去向。

他说：“很多人期望这些革命性技术——人工智能也是革命性的——能够产生巨大的成功。”

相反，“我们认为，在可预见的未来，我们的生态系统将受到数以千计的小打击和改进，从而推动增长，”科斯罗萨西补充道。

Uber 还利用人工智能重塑其内部运营。 该公司上个月解雇了约 10% 的客户服务人员，理由是人工智能可以提高效率。

在周三的电话会议上，克里希那穆蒂指出客户服务是“一个明确的领域，我们应该能够提高客户支持互动的质量并降低我们的工作成本。”

该公司还使用“代理荚”来寻找人工智能从财务到人力资源的用途。

科斯罗萨西在电话会议上表示，优步面向消费者的人工智能应用也在取得进展，尽管它们不太可能一下子实现。

这位首席执行官表示，Uber 每周为“数十万”次自动驾驶汽车出行提供便利——不到同期通过该应用程序发生的 3 亿次出行的 0.5%。

科斯罗萨西表示，相比之下，人工智能对于许多在线搜索用户来说已经变得很常见。 他补充说，与人工智能聊天机器人不同，优步通过机器人出租车实际使用人工智能需要现实世界的测试和政府批准。

科斯罗沙西表示，Uber 还在尝试人工智能的其他用途，以“改善消费者的基本体验”。 他提到了 Cart Assistant，它可以根据食谱或购物清单在 Uber 应用程序中创建杂货购物车，并根据客户的反馈编辑购物车。

科斯罗萨西说，购物车助手用户的购物车尺寸是未使用人工智能工具的用户的两倍。

“你应该期望人工智能能够为平均订单规模、我们服务的质量和可靠性做出贡献，并在正确的时间将正确的产品呈现在你面前，”他说。
